name: 07604 · Hasbrouck Hts, NJ
findings: ZIP 07604 (Hasbrouck Hts) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07604 (Hasbrouck Hts) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07604 (Hasbrouck Hts) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).

observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
